mostWorthwhile.text: Following the signal through gene activation and RNA production, then translation into procollagen, was most worthwhile: it connects cell specialization to a concrete product.

leastWorthwhile.text: The procollagen-production passage was less clear because it named procollagen without yet explaining how it relates to collagen.

surprise.text: The final construction clarified that fibroblasts remain separate from the matrix they help produce, rather than becoming the material themselves.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the route was fairly direct and offered few meaningful decisions.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting gene activity to secretion and the mechanical role of extracellular material made me curious about how these structures support tissues.
